partners.title: Built with ministries. Shaped by real use.

items.a: BT Servant is a free AI assistant from unfoldingWord that gives trusted, context-aware Scripture guidance through conversation, inside the messaging apps people already use and on the web. It helps disciples understand, study, teach, translate, and share God’s Word, and equip others to do the same.

items.q: What can I ask BT Servant?
items.a: Start from what you need: understand what a passage means; study its context, questions, and resources; teach with lessons and discussions; translate terms, meaning, and decisions; share the gospel clearly; or equip others to train and multiply leaders. The rest is a conversation.

items.q: Where can I use BT Servant?
items.a: On WhatsApp (+1 555-819-6461), on Telegram (@bt_servant_bot), on Signal, and in any web browser at app.btservant.ai. Ask in text or voice; there are no commands to learn.

items.q: How do I start a conversation?
items.a: Scan the QR code on this page with your phone, or tap the button for the app you already use. Send any question, then reply in text or voice. You can begin in a browser and continue on your phone later.

items.q: Which languages does BT Servant support?
items.a: English, Indonesian, Spanish, and many more languages. You can ask and get answers in text or by voice.

items.q: Where do BT Servant’s answers come from?
items.a: Answers are grounded in vetted biblical resources rather than the internet at large. Translation questions, for example, draw on Translation Words and Translation Academy. BT Servant supports pastors, teachers, and translators; it never replaces them.
BT Servant is a project of unfoldingWord, built with ministry partners ETEN Innovation Lab, Word Collective, and Spoken Worldwide. Its engine is published on GitHub, free to embed or self-host.

items.q: Can my organization use BT Servant?
items.a: Yes. Teams can use it, customize it, or integrate it: free access for the whole team; custom modes such as Trainer, Translator, and Checking; or the engine itself inside your own tools.
